method.driver_y_source: woofer_seed._panel_fit_geometry(box, BL_DEMO_DRIVER_MOVING_DIAMETER_M, no explicit y, BL_DEMO_PORT_WALL_M, BL_DEMO_PORT_ROUNDOVER_M, BL_DEMO_CONE_DEPTH_M, BL_VALIDATE_CLEARANCE_M, allow_auto_y=True) -> _max_legal_panel_y(...)[0], i.e. the identical two calls bl_panel_fit_separation() makes for the screen. Inputs taken from each row: external_width/height/depth_mm, wall_mm, port_throat_area_cm2; BL defaults otherwise.
method.formula_check: driver_y = max(0, external_height_mm/2 - wall_mm - 100.0 mm (moving diameter/2) - 3.0 mm (BL clearance) - 1e-12)
method.assumed_values: none: every kept row's box has external height, wall and port area, so driver_y is resolved, not assumed. All four drivers in the runs have published geometry YAMLs (frame OD 261.0/316.0 mm), so every row carried a frame solid.
method.envelope: rebuilt from each artifact's stored envelope mm via envelope_from_bbox_m
method.rear_depth: row['driver_geometry']['rear_depth_mm_used'] == driver depth_mm (no mounting_depth published), same value the screen passed
